title: G0 preflight result — is the reference provably buildable and runnable before G1 dispatches miners
description: Written by scripts/preflight.py as the last G0 action, alongside the human-readable PREFLIGHT.md. Read by autopilot.py preflight and by SKILL.md's phase detection: a workbench with sources.yaml filled but no preflight.json is still in G0. Contains no timestamp on purpose — two runs on an unchanged tree must produce a byte-identical file, and staleness is answered by reference.pinned_commit and reference.checkout_head, which move when the thing being checked moves.

verdict.description: Not-ready blocks G1 dispatch only. sources.yaml and license-posture.md commit and push regardless — none of the Not-ready causes changes a G0 decision.

kind.description: third-party | own-code, as recorded in sources.yaml. own-code plus a running instance is E8's gating condition.

pinned_commit.description: From sources.yaml. Every lane-D citation is written against it.

checkout.description: Path to the reference checkout that was actually inspected.

checkout_head.description: git rev-parse HEAD in that checkout. Differing from pinned_commit is the one Not-ready this script cannot be talked out of.

lanes.description: Per-lane, because the causes are not interchangeable: a wrong commit poisons lane D's citations and nothing else, an unreachable instance takes out B and C and leaves D untouched. A black-box reference (no repo declared) leaves D `degraded`: docs and API only, nothing wrong.

status.description: Only `fail` makes the run Not-ready. `gap` is a named, costed degradation — a build detected but not executed is a gap, never a pass. `skip` is a check with nothing to inspect, including every source check of a black-box reference.

effect.description: What this costs downstream, and how to close it. Required in spirit for every non-pass: a gap nobody can act on is noise.
